findings.summary: The four 'after' value labels (11.0 %, 15.5 %, 13.5 %, 18.5 %) are drawn in the series green #2e8b57 at 4.24:1 against the white canvas, just under the 4.5:1 WCAG AA threshold that applies to 14 pt normal-weight text, while the 'before' labels beside them are #444444 at 9.74:1. The labels are legible and the bar lengths repeat the same numbers, so no reader is blocked; the fix, if taken, is to draw the value text in a darker green (for example #1f5c3a, 7.9:1) and keep #2e8b57 for the bar fill, which needs only 3:1.

rubric_items.contrast: defect - the eight value labels split by series: the four 'before' labels are #444444 at 9.74:1, but the four 'after' labels are drawn in the series green #2e8b57 at 4.24:1 against white, just under the 4.5:1 WCAG AA floor for 14 pt normal-weight text. Tick labels (#52514e, 7.9:1), the axis title (#0b0b0b, 19.7:1) and the bound label (#555555, 7.5:1) all clear it, and the grey bars at #929292 (3.11:1) clear the 3:1 bar for non-text marks. The green labels remain legible and the bar lengths carry the same numbers, so nothing is lost to a reader.
rubric_items.data_ink: pass - ink is the eight bars, eight value labels, the dotted bound line, the legend and the axis text; there is no gradient, background fill or decorative band, and the bar thickness carries the only plotted quantity.
rubric_items.decoration: pass - white canvas, no gridlines, no shading, every axis despined to the bars' baseline; the lone non-data line is the dotted 5 % bound, which is the threshold the text measures against and is labelled as such.
rubric_items.label_collision: pass - ink bounding box (17,20)-(1379,698) sits inside the 1400x720 canvas with 17px left, 20px right, 20px top and 21px bottom, so nothing is clipped; each value label clears its bar end by about 18px, the bound label sits in clear space above the bars, and the legend is separated from it and from every bar.
rubric_items.legibility: pass - one 1400x720 horizontal-bar chart reads at a glance: four categories on the y axis (gate wrappers top-level, gate wrappers depth 2, any script top-level, any script depth 2), each with a grey 'before' bar and a green 'after' bar, every value printed at the bar end (5.0/11.0, 5.5/15.5, 7.0/13.5, 9.5/18.5 %), a dotted 5 % bound with a direct label, and a legend naming the two series.
rubric_items.table_form: pass - the content is a threshold comparison, four after-measures set against a 5 % bound with each bar pair's before-measure beside it; a table of eight percentages would not show how far every after-value sits above the bound, which is what the figure exists to say.
